fields.title: Read the texts about festivals. Answer the questions. Write A, B or C.
fields.content:
A

Hi Jordi,

Would you like to come to a festival in my grandparents' town? The festival is called 'El Colacho', and it started in 1620. It's a great festival for families and children. There's music, dancing and amazing food.

I'm going to travel there with Javier on Friday. Please join us!

Love,

Carmen

B
Digby Food Festival

David Smith

This is my favourite festival, because I love eating and talking about food. The festival is two years old. My friends went last year and they loved it, so I went last week. There were chefs at the festival, and they cooked a lot of food. I had some amazing cheese, bread and meat. I liked the event, but it was £35, so it was expensive.

C

Next month, we're going to visit Thailand for the Songkran festival. It's a party in the street from 13th to 15th April. I'm from Russia, and in April it's cold, but in Thailand it's very hot! Songkran is a festival of water. People wear beautiful clothes with a lot of colours. It's an old festival, and it's really fun.
